caption:
The video captures a close-up, shallow-depth-of-field view of a single raw, red ground-beef patty resting on a dark, flat, oiled cooking surface. The patty sits in the lower center and holds the same position and orientation throughout. A bright horizontal light streak sits in the upper right, fixed against the blurred background, while a thin oil sheen surrounds the patty's base. Faint wisps of steam rise sporadically above the meat and along its edges against the dark, out-of-focus surroundings.

Small bubbles form, swell, and burst in the oil around the patty's perimeter, with their size and position shifting from moment to moment across the hot surface. The exposed top of the meat keeps its raw red color and textured surface, showing no visible browning, rotation, or translation despite the surrounding activity. The bright background streak and the patty's position stay fixed, indicating a stationary camera while the sizzling liquid continues to move around the visible base.
